assignment_authority: Stone-Zsela as Chief in every tentative component judgment majority
eligibility_limits: Stone-Zsela does not join the independent statutory threshold/action, adverse-effect and detailed remedial rationales; Scalia and Thomas reject the continuing-pertinence rule and statutory mandate and reserve adverse effect. The six eligible Associates join every part. No division of authorship is necessary.
fit_and_strongest_alternative: Kennedy is the strongest alternative: his Reich opinion distinguishes authority, sovereign consent and prospective remedies, and his current joins accommodate genuine historical investigative value. Breyer can perform those same distinctions faithfully and has concrete fit for a contextual pertinence inquiry that respects agency expertise under the correct statute, as his Allentown separate ground and Oubre concurrence show. Hudson and Bay Area Laundry confirm his assigned work coordinating substantive conditions with separate monetary consequences. Neither candidate supplies an indispensable new accommodation. Both can deliver the unchanged complete test and all necessary joins; Breyer has the lower count, 2 versus 3, and is preferred under section 8. No later-career evidence, automatic self-assignment, interest-based exclusion or policy outside section 8 is used.
